verdict.rationale: Datadog has its own first-party Service Level Objectives documentation, and a separate Monitors page covers alerting, so defining SLOs is a native capability. The pack shows only page titles, though: nothing confirms error-budget tracking or SLO burn-rate alert types, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented error-budget calculation and display, documented burn-rate alert configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts
